correctness.rationale: Every case is derived from exact divisor-class identities on a smooth grid blow-up. The grid ideal generators yield a basepoint-free nef class L with intersection 2r+2s-rs against -K. Positive wall gives explicit effective-plus-big decompositions, negative wall excludes even the pseudo-effective closure, and equality forces exact disjoint-fiber multiplicities with complete integrality analysis. Every point blow-up loses positive anticanonical sections because its required point multiplicity exceeds that of the unique boundary representative. The standalone integer program checks 784 grid pairs but is not used to infer the universal statement.

value.rationale: The sharp complete birational trichotomy for every rectangular grid with r,s>=3 is a natural enlargement of the 2026 construction, not an arbitrary slice. It locates the last pseudo-effective anticanonical grid families, including two novel 18-point configurations whose unique ring generator has different degree from the classical 4-by-4 example, and shows their all-center one-blowup fragility. Such precise positivity and graded-ring information informs rational surface birational geometry and contrasts with K^2 alone; it is not a mere low-degree vanishing test.
